decisions.reason: Removing the click-to-clear placeholder behavior does not alter the independent requirement that the Title field retain its formatting.
Persistent help labels remain valid independently of whether one field clears placeholder text when activated.
The requirement for a visible editable-field cue remains unchanged; removing one placeholder interaction does not necessarily remove the accepted grey visual cue or resolve its existing ambiguity.

The candidate already has a message-151 MODIFY establishing simple editable text without content controls. Removing the separate placeholder-clear attribute requires no additional update or removal in this candidate.
The Board Meeting dropdown is an independently accepted control and is not changed by removal of a placeholder-clearing behavior in a different text field.
The accepted checklist control remains enabled independently of the removed placeholder-clearing behavior.
Numbered-list alignment and formatting are unrelated to placeholder activation behavior.
Pasted-table containment and layout stability are unaffected by removal of a text-field placeholder interaction.
Bullet sizing, alignment, balance, and color remain unchanged by the placeholder behavior decision.
The general Windows and multi-user stability requirement remains valid without modification.
Style-name prefix requirements are independent of placeholder clearing in an interactive field.
Manual line-break behavior after pasted content is unrelated to removal of the placeholder-clear behavior.
